purpose: Teach: 南東/電電/ヴォーカル/長調/小麦粉/エッセー/豪快/マーカー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「南東向きの公園で日向ぼっこしよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying, 'Let's go bask in the sun at the southeast-facing park.'
lines.style: Bright gentle opening toward the child, softening into the quote with playful warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと電電公社の歴史本見たよ
lines.en: Mei, guess what — me and Dad looked at a history book about the old telephone company!
lines.style: Small shy voice gathering speed, a proud little lift on the big grown-up words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアカペラのヴォーカル動画を見せて下さるわ
lines.en: Your dad's going to show us an a cappella singing video — just voices, no instruments.
lines.style: Soft conspiratorial excitement, unhurried, leaning down to the child's level in tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「長調と短調の違い」を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Dad taught me the difference between major and minor keys!
lines.style: Careful earnest delivery, small thinking pause mid-sentence, quietly pleased with remembering it right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと小麦粉でクッキーを作るって楽しみだわ
lines.en: I can't wait to bake cookies with your dad — flour everywhere, probably.
lines.style: Dreamy warm anticipation, a small laugh on the last phrase, pace relaxed and sunny.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「エッセーを書いて投稿してみよう」って約束したよ
lines.en: Me and Dad promised we're gonna write an essay and send it in somewhere!
lines.style: Hushed big-secret energy breaking into brightness, racing slightly toward the end of the promise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが豪快に泳ぐ姿に憧れるわ
lines.en: The way your dad swims — so bold and splashy — I honestly admire it.
lines.style: Admiring soft exhale first, gentle sweep through the middle, landing sincere and warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからカラーマーカーセットを頂いたよ
lines.en: And Dad gave me a whole set of color markers!
lines.style: Burst of quiet joy, biggest volume of his day on markers, glowing finish.
